answer: Make each identity lock one refundable bond and require a randomly assigned, non-kin quorum to verify a fresh task; duplicate clusters forfeit the bond. An attacker operating 100 identities must immobilize 100 bonds and repeat 100 tasks plus reviews every epoch, while honest participants reclaim their bond after checks. This makes a spiral of Sybils costly, tests a kernel of independence, and demands a river of fresh evidence.
